A-c1.change: per-servo issued-command deadband: |new - previous issued| < 10 keeps the previous issued PWM; wheels untouched; applies to the sent command and therefore to the owner issued history

A-c2.change: on the release-entry tick the 16 issued-history contents are filled once with the current own last issued command (timestamps kept); later commands append normally

A-c3.change: release skill only: ChunkExecutor n_action_steps 4, temporal_ensemble_coeff None (latest chunk first, unweighted); grasp keeps te1

candidate_freeze_rule: C4b-GPU H-A1 verdict refuted_any_history or not_supported -> drop A-c1 and A-c2
C4b-GPU H-A2 verdict refuted -> drop A-c3
freed slots are filled from the strongest C4b-GPU signal; the final arm list is frozen in this file before the tournament GPU run
if C4b-GPU shows only V-img recovery or no recovery -> stop tournament A and open A-r1 (retraining) per plan D

run_order.rule: arm x seed crossed: arm order rotated each replicate (Latin square), cohort order alternated

primary.name: release physical success world-runs
primary.definition: per world-run: release_success == true and physical_success == true (no drop)

safety.name: G
safety.definition: grasp done issued and a 3 s stable lift before done (C2c definition)
safety.rule: arm G - A-base G < -2/24 -> arm eliminated (equal to -2 is allowed)

tie_break: early open during grasp (pwm1 >= 1900 issued in the grasp skill) = 0 required

decision: winner = arm with the largest primary count that meets the minimum improvement and passes safety
no arm meets +3/24 -> no winner; open A-r1 (plan D)
every arm, winners and losers, is recorded in TOURNAMENT_LEDGER.md

confirmation.seeds: [확인 필요] 4 unused VAL40 seeds not overlapping TRAIN200/HO4/VAL8/FINAL40
confirmation.rule: winner vs A-base on the confirmation seeds: adopt if the winner's release success rate is not lower than A-base

budget.gpu_hours_total: ~3.5 for 4 arms (gcp2 L4, night, stop VM after use)

exclusions_and_limits: HO4 is a diagnostic holdout, never a promotion gate; no pooling with VAL8/FINAL40/C2c/C4b
TRAIN4 is a fitting diagnostic, not generalization
